canonicalPrompt.text:
Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Quinia Eshar: 19-year-old man, 196 cm (very-tall), unmistakably soft rounded construction with a clearly evident, naturally wider middle, short-to-average limbs, no cinched or flat waist, and gentle limb contours, skin value band-1-lightest. Face: square compact face; asymmetric brows and broad cheek planes; long straight nose, narrow upper lip; faint freckles. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: black, medium-loose, deliberate accent: none. Wardrobe: apron-workwear-layers, specifically a work shirt, asymmetrical apron layers, reinforced trousers, and sturdy shoes; low-profile toggles and articulated knee folds; bounded palette teal-brown. Visible personal details: an extensive matte botanical tattoo language over one shoulder, torso edge, and forearm; a hand-painted hem mark. Make the hair construction the primary recognition silhouette. Maintenance cue: severe grooming softened by one unruly feature. Color treatment: uses the palette boldly in large blocks. Pose cue: one thumb hooks lightly beneath the waist wrap while the other hand rests open. Include a clay tea token only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
